name: DHL Supply Chain - DC - Obetz OH

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 2160 McGaw Road, Obetz OH 43207 (at the McGaw Rd / Frusta Dr intersection), the historic 'Exel Logistics Columbus Public Warehouse' — Exel Inc. is DHL Supply Chain's legal/legacy brand. Roster gave no address; web research surfaced the Yelp/CMac listing 'Exel Logistics Columbus Public Warehouse, 2160 McGaw Rd, Obetz OH 43207' and a CBRE industrial lease listing for the same address. Google Geocoding API would not resolve the McGaw Rd house number (returned ZIP centroid); located the building via OpenStreetMap centerlines for McGaw Rd and Frusta Dr, then satellite/Street View confirmation.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate, barrier arm, or guard booth visible at any approach. The NE dock court is open and accessed directly from the public service road; confirmed in 2019 and 2025 Street View. Flagged as uncertain because the imagery is partly dated.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run along the NE face of the parallelogram building; 2019 Street View shows a row of doors with trailers backed in. Banded 25-50; exact count not resolvable from overexposed z20 satellite — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a handful of trailers in the open dock court; no dedicated drop-trailer lot. Site activity looks light in current imagery (a CBRE listing shows ~125,100 sq ft available for lease, suggesting partial vacancy).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Obetz sits within the continuous Columbus metro industrial fabric immediately off I-270 / Alum Creek Drive; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Open driveway with no gate or marked lane structure; lane counts not determinable.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
